title: A new class of carbonate–oxychloride solid electrolytes for high-performance sodium-ion all-solid-state batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE03490F, Paper
Xinmiao Wang, Simeng Zhang, Junyi Yue, Xingyu Wang, Yang Xu, Yue Gong, Liyu Zhou, Changtai Zhao, Jianwen Liang, Xiangzhen Zhu, Han Wu, Xiaolong Yan, Biwei Xiao, Meng Li, Chenxiang Li, Shuo Wang, Xueliang Sun, Xiaona Li
Novel Na-ion solid-state electrolytes (MCly–xNa2CO3, M = Ta, Nb, Hf, Zr, and Al) were synthesized rapidly by ball milling. Conductivity of 1.11 mS cm−1 was achieved in 10 min for TaCl5–1.2Na2CO3, with optimized TaCl5–0.5Na2CO3 reaching 5.01 mS cm−1.
